canonical_human_statement: Let M be an oriented smooth n-manifold with boundary and let omega be a smooth compactly supported differential (n-1)-form on M. With the outward-normal-first induced orientation on the boundary and boundary inclusion i, the integral over M of d omega equals the integral over the boundary of i^* omega.
